entry.title: Georgia Guidestones
entry.note: The pre-demolition aerial image locates the granite cluster and the west tablet. The fabricator’s dimensions determine the five uprights and capstone. The central stone and capstone use cardinal axes, with approximately 55-degree outer axes based on the tablet diagram and the documented lunar alignment. The engraved panels use script-specific marks and line layouts to convey the original carving at viewer distances. Small differences in lettering, exact tablet size, rough edge contours and ground-level landscaping are approximate. The viewing date selects the standing monument. Surrounding terrain, roads and fields come from modern map data. Historical placement requires an explicit viewingDate within the recorded appearance interval; excluded from the default current world.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
